title: Deku-Seed Bag Upgrades
intro: Your bag starts at 30 Deku Seeds. Two upgrades raise it to 40 and then 50.
source_note: Written for this app. Locations and requirements follow the Ocarina of Time remake.

entries.title: Castle Town - Shooting Gallery
entries.steps: Play the Shooting Gallery in Castle Town and finish with a perfect score. The reward is the first upgrade, taking you to 40 seeds.

entries.title: Lost Woods - Hanging target
entries.steps: Enter the Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest and turn right straight away to find a hanging target. Hit its centre three times in a row and a Deku Scrub appears with the second upgrade, taking you to 50 seeds.
